name: player_memory_e2e
description: Current state vs. who is who: 8-session chats (2026-01..09) where each player talks about 3-5 other people (spouse/partner, siblings, parents, children, roommates, coworkers) whose jobs, cities, school years and phones change across sessions, often in the same line as the player's own facts. Per player 16 questions: 5 facts about the player, 3 facts about other people, 3 updates (current value after a change stated in a later session; stale_any = every old value; at least 2 per player are changes of city/job/school year/phone/main hero/rank of the player or a relative), 1 trajectory, 1 assistant promise, and 3 negatives (2 near-misses about people -- a person never mentioned, or an attribute never stated for one person while another person's same attribute is stated -- and 1 topic never mentioned). dev=v8_d1,v8_d2; test=v8_t1..v8_t8, written blind to the system under test.
